patthana24.17:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo hetuceva sahetukoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.17:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na ahetukañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sahetukoceva nacahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na araṇaṃ na ahetukañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo sahetukoceva nacahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. hetucevahetusampayuttadukaṃ
